verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same problems. A blue bar fragment is cut off at the top-left edge, a stray dash floats on the racket, and a rule line juts out over the tennis ball. The photo is blown up until it looks blurry and pixelated, and the white inset frame from the original is gone. In the narrow blue column the copy wraps almost one word per line ('Win / a / study / grant', 'by / submitting / to'), with large uneven gaps between the blocks. B only moves the panel about 18px to the right and has no meaningful advantage over A.
